title: MANAGED PCM TO SPECIFIC DAC / ADVANCED DSP
verdict: IN_PROGRESS_HARDENED — Managed execution identity is per-instance and STOP is atomically identity-bound; GStreamer pipeline latency is measured through the real Query API; effective evidence retires coherently; headroom has numeric sample-peak evidence and dynamic PEQ is measured. Physical ALSA/DAC, durable DSP profile (F13), F11 UI, true peak and FIR/resample/dither remain open. F06 stays READY.

plan_rules: specific selected device + one current ALSA playback binding only
binding must belong to the selected device and be currently available
stale selection revision is a typed refusal
output rate = source rate unless the compiled plan changes rate
output channels = source channels unless the plan changes channels
terminal container only from proven current capability
deterministic execution id over device/binding/selection/processing facts
no Direct OutputPlan reuse and no allow_processing flag
managed_pcm.executor_sequence: stage ONE managed strict sink in the child -> load -> bounded wait for child acceptance -> processing install through the canonical authority -> verify child-reported managed identity
managed_pcm.host_seam: STAGE_MANAGED + QUERY_MANAGED_IDENTITY (protocol v1). The child builds a strict alsasink for the SELECTED binding, records plan/device/format/rate/channels/lab_sink, and never sets Direct identity.
managed_pcm.no_fallback: a missing/unavailable device or a rejected load raises a typed ManagedPcmExecutionError and STOPS; the default output is never used and no identity claim is returned
managed_pcm.headless_proof: tests/audio_phase2/test_managed_pcm_productive.py: real supervised host, managed identity device hw:2,0, lab_sink=true (explicit lab-only override), real DSP install + capture
managed_pcm.physical_status: NOT_RUN: requires MICHI_MANAGED_PHYSICAL_TEST=1 and an explicit MICHI_MANAGED_PHYSICAL_DEVICE; the physical campaign is PARKED
managed_pcm.pending_integration: durable Managed/DSP profile repository + F11 selection surface; physical ALSA/DAC run (operator gate, campaign PARKED); measured pipeline/sink latency

staging_isolation.guard: stage_direct_load rejects a staged Managed preparation (DIRECT_STAGE_CONFLICT) symmetrically to MANAGED_STAGE_CONFLICT
properties: one load consumes exactly one family's recipe
conflicts are rejected before any state mutation
a rejected payload never reaches the next load

session_integration.worker_owner_split: the worker builds the managed plan, executes staging+load+acceptance+DSP install+identity; the owner only commits session state after generation/intent/binding revalidation
session_integration.async: prepare_for_media_async; a stale generation or changed intent aborts the prepared execution (superseded_before_commit/intent_changed_before_commit)
session_integration.no_fallback: a refused plan or failed execution raises typed and leaves no default-output audio
session_integration.evidence_precondition: Managed preparation requires cached conclusive terminal evidence; without it the planner refuses TERMINAL_FORMAT_UNPROVEN (fail closed, never the default sink). Qualification is the existing authority.

runtime_evidence.identity: managed identity carries plan/device/format/rate/channels, lab_sink, loaded, host supervisor generation (executor), and the sink pad's negotiated caps
runtime_evidence.evidence_level: gstreamer_negotiated when the sink pad exposes current caps; configured_only otherwise — no negotiated claim is fabricated
runtime_evidence.post_install: the executor re-reads identity after the DSP install

managed_pcm.signal_truth: additive output-family event stream on the ONE SignalTruthRecorder: managed READY/RUNNING/UNAVAILABLE/RELEASED with execution id, device, processing plan, transform policy, runtime identity; bit_perfect is tri-state and never True; DAC candidate/active truth untouched

resolver_fix.fix: explicit family dispatch (_uses_specific_device) preserves is_direct_path semantics; MANAGED gets full planner facts and pending_device_id
resolver_fix.engine_guard: ENGINE_UNSUPPORTED_FOR_MANAGED when the active engine is not GStreamer (no implicit switch)

selection.profile: stable_managed_profile (path MANAGED, processing permitted, fallback STOP, software volume)
selection.device_change: select_device and normal playback intent preserve the Managed family
selection.persistence: profile + selection are written through the canonical profile authority (survives an in-process reload); the durable repository/UI remain F13/F11

productive_dsp.authority: the composition exposes set_processing_profile / processing_profile (canonical ProcessingProfile)
productive_dsp.chain: ProcessingGraph -> EffectiveProcessingGraphResolver -> ProcessingGraphCompiler -> ManagedPcmOutputPlanner -> ManagedPcmExecutor -> AudioProcessingService -> hosted GStreamer
productive_dsp.bypass: a disabled/absent profile selects the identity Managed route and retires stale EFFECTIVE processing truth
productive_dsp.headroom: profile.auto_headroom inserts ONE visible preamp node (-required boost); no hidden level change; required_headroom_db/with_auto_headroom are pure and tested

ownership.stop: STOP_MANAGED atomically matches plan_id + execution_id + device; a stale request leaves the current execution untouched
ownership.cleanup: stale is expected; failed/unknown cleanup records OutputCleanupDiagnostic (never a clean-stop claim)

dac_truth.evidence: supported is True AND exact device/fingerprint/rate/channels; ALSA carriers mapped to GStreamer raw formats (alsa_to_gst_format); UNKNOWN and other tuples are refused (MANAGED_TERMINAL_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE)
dac_truth.post_install: identity is re-read after DSP; unavailable post-install identity fails closed; host generation must be a positive int (callable-safe)
dac_truth.tests: productive flow strict-evidence parametrization + executor post-install tests

latency.published: processing_truth().latency = {expected_samples (compiled plan), source, pipeline_samples=None, sink_samples=None, physical='not_measured'}

definitive_flow.path: _build_services -> fake Linux/ALSA topology -> cached qualification -> SelectionCoordinator (managed) -> ProductiveOutputRequestResolver -> prepare_for_media_async -> ManagedPcmOutputPlanner -> ManagedPcmExecutor -> AudioProcessingService -> real GStreamer host -> lab sink -> runtime readback -> OutputSession RUNNING -> SignalTruthRecorder
scenarios: DSP preamp preset + preset change (new plan identity)
device loss retires route, identity and processing truth
identity-bound stop (stale never stops a newer execution)

parametric_eq.coefficients: RBJ Audio-EQ-Cookbook (F04 biquad math) computed parent-side; enabled bands only; disabled bands never materialize
parametric_eq.native_execution: one audioiirfilter per band inside the existing processing bin; exact a/b readback before EFFECTIVE
goldens: disabled bands produce no factories and no mutation
productive spectral proof at 44100/48000/96000 Hz: -6 dB @125 Hz +6 dB @1 kHz within +/-2 dB
proven bypass returns the level to the baseline
parametric_eq.readback_proof: commit_candidate validates the installed filter cascade coefficients against the plan before publish_effective

dynamic.session: PEQ A -> B -> bypass under Managed: distinct plan ids and execution instances, readback-proven EFFECTIVE, identity route retires truth
dynamic.measured: flat -> +6 -> -6 -> bypass on the same host within +/-2 dB at 1 kHz; bypass retirement verified

direct_regression.evidence: full suite 5768 passed / 4 skipped; build-block subset (audio_phase2 + phase2 + architecture + dac) 1471 passed / 2 skipped
direct_regression.note: no Direct staging/recipe code path was modified

residuals_closed.truth_lock: invalidate_effective mutates truth under the short state lock and clears the latency estimate
residuals_closed.memory_bound: committed candidate plans are pruned after validation; latency provenance is retained
residuals_closed.pipeline_latency: managed identity reports GStreamer query_latency (ns + samples at the negotiated rate); unmeasured is None; physical is a separate claim
residuals_closed.host_sigkill: real SIGKILL test: host-loss fan-out retires EFFECTIVE, stale release is diagnostic-only and cannot crash the owner
residuals_closed.ownership: spec amendment authorized the exact remaining F06 files; spec sha 826381f1..., alignment GO

execution_identity.instance_identity: process-unique exec-instance:<epoch>:<seq> issued by the session authority for EVERY managed preparation
execution_identity.propagation: session -> managed_prepare -> executor recipe -> child managed identity -> STOP_MANAGED comparison
execution_identity.stop_match: plan_id + execution instance + device, checked and stopped atomically in the child
execution_identity.proof: A->B with the same plan/file/DAC: same plan_id, different instances; A's stop is stale and B keeps playing with its EFFECTIVE truth; duplicate stop is stale

latency.api: Gst.Query.new_latency() + pipeline.query() + query.parse_latency() (pipeline.query_latency does not exist in PyGObject)
latency.reported: source=gstreamer_runtime, measurement_type=pipeline_reported, live, min_ns, max_ns; CLOCK_TIME_NONE -> None
latency.samples: pipeline_latency_samples derived from the negotiated rate
latency.truth: processing_truth publishes only the compiled-plan estimate with provenance; pipeline/sink/physical are separate and unmeasured claims
latency.proof: productive test requires a valid numeric min_ns (0 is valid), not None-acceptance

signal_truth.retirement: ONE locked helper clears plan, state, latency, runtime identity and readback provenance on host loss, refresh failure, invalidation, bypass and the managed identity route
signal_truth.stop_semantics: stopped or failed/unknown retire the claim; STALE never touches a newer execution's truth
signal_truth.tests: host loss, refresh failure, bypass, identity route, SIGKILL after commit and dead-host prepare

headroom.metrics: sample_peak, samples_over_full_scale, exceeds_full_scale, headroom_db (SAMPLE peak only)
headroom.proof: 0.9 FS sine at 44.1/48/96: baseline ~0.9; PEQ +6 dB -> >1.4 and over-FS samples; auto-headroom preamp (-6 dB) -> <1.0 and zero over-FS samples
headroom.not_claimed: true peak / intersample peaks / analog clipping
